name: The Way of the Krayt Dragon

description.value:
As a bonus action, you can spend one minute in a threatening stance. While in the stance, the first time each turn you hit with a Strength-based melee weapon attack, you may deal extra damage equal to your Strength modifier. If another creature is within 5 feet of the original target and within your reach, you may instead try to deal that extra damage to the second creature: if the attack roll would also have hit it, it takes damage equal to your Strength modifier, of the same type as the original attack.

The stance ends early if you're incapacitated or killed. You must finish a long rest before using this feature again.
